title: Urban Decay RP
description: A gritty post-apocalyptic resource pack. Crumbling concrete, rusted metal, and dying nature.
body:
# Urban Decay

> *The world didn't end in fire. It just... stopped caring.*

**Urban Decay** transforms every biome into a haunting post-apocalyptic wasteland.
Concrete crumbles, metal rusts, leaves wither, and the sky turns an ominous gray.

---

## Features

- **140+ custom textures** covering all biomes
- Cracked **concrete & asphalt** replacing stone and cobblestone
- **Rusted metal plates** for iron blocks with rivet details
- **Decayed wood** — rotting planks, corroded logs across all wood types
- **Withered leaves** — desaturated, dying foliage for every tree variant
- **Contaminated water** — murky, oil-slicked water texture
- **Ominous red moon** and overcast sun
- **Nether** reimagined as an industrial hellscape
- **The End** as a dead, crumbling ruin
- Custom **GUI** — metal-frame hotbar and battery-style health bar
- **sounds.json** ready for custom SFX (see README)

---

## Supported Biomes

| Overworld | Nether | The End |
|---|---|---|
| Forest, Jungle, Bamboo | Nether Wastes | End Stone ruins |
| Savanna, Desert | Crimson / Warped Forest | Purpur structures |
| Snowy Tundra, Ice | Soul Sand Valley | Obsidian towers |
| Swamp, Mangrove | Basalt Deltas | — |
| Dark Oak, Cherry Grove | — | — |
| Mushroom Island | — | — |
| Ocean, Deep Caves | — | — |

---

## Installation

1. Download the `.zip` — **do not extract**
2. Place in `.minecraft/resourcepacks/`  
   *or* drag & drop into the Resource Pack screen
3. Enable in **Options → Resource Packs**

**Compatible with:** Java Edition 1.20.x (pack_format 15)  
**Resolution:** 32×32

---

## Customize Sounds

Drop `.ogg` files into `assets/minecraft/sounds/custom/` to activate:
- `concrete_break.ogg` — block break
- `metal_step.ogg` — footstep
- `dark_ambient.ogg` — background music

Free CC0 sounds: [freesound.org](https://freesound.org)
